# Add your assets here

Add your public résumé as `Darshil_Kalyani_Resume.pdf`, then set `resumeUrl` in `../site-config.js` to `assets/Darshil_Kalyani_Resume.pdf`.

Add genuine project screenshots, ideally WebP files under 200 KB each. See the main README for the image markup. The page currently shows explicitly labeled screenshot placeholders.

Do not upload your internal master résumé, internship dossiers, API keys, or private project files here. Everything in the site folder can be served publicly once you publish it.
